```{r}
set.seed(333)
my_df <- tibble(
  x = rnorm(10, mean = 100, sd = 10),
  y = runif(10, min = 30, max = 130),
  z = rlnorm(10, 2, 2)
)
my_df1 <- my_df[1:3, 1:3]
```



```{r}
T <- function(df) {
# allocate empty tibble for transposed df
out <- matrix(
  ncol = nrow(df), 
  nrow = ncol(df)
  )
# i row, j column
# column
for (j in 1:ncol(df)) {
# row
  for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
    out[[j, i]] <-  df[[i, j]]
  }
}
# have to set colnames on matrix to keep as_tibble happy
colnames(out) <- paste("V", 1:nrow(df), sep = "_")
as_tibble(out)
}
```

```{r}
my_df1
```


```{r}
T(my_df1)
```

```{r}
# Fast and dirty
TT <- function(df) {
  d = dim(df)
  i = d[1]
  j = d[2]
  v = unlist(df)
  m = matrix(v, byrow = TRUE, ncol = i)
  m
  }
```

```{r}
TT(my_df1)
```

```{r}
decide_number <- function(x) {
#  stopifnot(is.numeric(x) & length(x) == 1)
  if (x > 0) {
    paste(x, "is greater than zero")
  } else if (x < 0) {
    paste(x, "is less than zero")
  } else {
    paste(x, "is zero")
  }
}
```

```{r}
decide_number(-7)
```

```{r}
try(decide_number(c(-7, 2)))
```

```{r}
decide_number_vec <- function(x) {
  vec <- vector(mode = "character", length = length(x))
  for (i in seq_along(x)) {
    vec[i] <- decide_number(x[i])
  }
  vec
}
```

```{r}
decide_number_vec(c(-7, 2))
```


```{r}
decide_numvec <- function(x) {
  stopifnot(is.numeric(x))
  x_g <- x > 0
  x_l <- x < 0
  x_ans <- case_when(
    x_g == TRUE~ paste(x, "is greater than zero"),
    x_l == TRUE ~ paste(x, "is less than zero"),
    !(x_g | x_l) == TRUE ~ paste(x, "is zero")
  )
  x_ans
}
```

```{r}
decide_numvec(c(-7, 2))
```

```{r}
# checking speed
set.seed(444)
test_vec <- sample(x = -10:10, size = 10000, replace = TRUE)
# Unit: milliseconds
# commented out to run document
# fix error
microbenchmark::microbenchmark(decide_numvec(test_vec), decide_number_vec(test_vec))
```

## Unknown length of output

```{r}
# rnorm with different means
uol_list  <- function(means) {
  out <- vector("list", length = length(means))
  for(i in seq_along(means)) {
    n <- sample(50:100, 1)
    out[[i]] <- rnorm(n, means[i])
  }
out
}
```

```{r}
uol_list(c(0.5, -2, 1.25))
```

```{r}
uol_list(c(0.5, -2, 1.25)) |> unlist() |> str()
```

```{r}
# rnorm with different means
uol_list  <- function(means) {
  out <- vector("list", length = length(means))
  for(i in seq_along(means)) {
    n <- sample(50:100, 1)
    out[[i]] <- rnorm(n, means[i])
  }
# return vector
unlist(out)
}
```

```{r}
uol_list(c(0.5, -2, 1.25)) |> str()
```

```{r}
# do while abs(r) < 1.96, then print drawn values
cond <- TRUE
rl <- list()
i = 0
while(cond) {
  r = rnorm(n = 1)
  i = i + 1
  rl = append(rl, r)
  if(abs(r) > 1.96) {
    cond = FALSE
    rl = list_c(rl)
    print(rl)
  }
}
```

```{r}
list_c(
  map(
    map(
      .x = my_df, 
      .f = mean), 
    .f = round, 
    # sent via ...
    digits = 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
my_df |> 
map(
  .f = mean
  ) |> 
  map(
    .f = round,
    digits = 2
  ) |> 
  unlist()
```
